Explore updates Pricing Book a Demo Log in Get Sintra AI Make Sintra yours This summer, Sintra became more yours than ever. A team you shape around your business, a chat that does far more of the work, and a workspace that learns how you run things, so you can operate like a company several times your size. AI employees An AI employee trained on your business Sintra's 12 built-in specialists are still here, and now you can create your own. Design a custom AI employee trained on how your business works, give it the skills the job needs, and publish your best ones for others to hire. Customize your own AI employee IMPROVED Tailor a personal AI employee to exactly what your business needs: the right skills, the right knowledge, and a face to match. Head to Helpers, describe the job, and Sintra sets up the specialist for you, alongside its 12 built-in ones. A marketplace for helpers IMPROVED Publish what you build and discover what others have made. Browse curated shelves and categories, and hire the right helper wherever you find one in the app. Earn from what you build IMPROVED Get paid automatically when others use a helper you've published, and share it anywhere with a public link. Bring a helper into any chat NEW @-mention any helper inside a conversation to pull it in, or start a fresh chat with a specific one from your homepage. The right specialist is always a step away. Favorite your go-to helpers NEW Star the helpers you use most and they stay pinned to the top of your list, so your regulars are always one tap away. Find helpers by meaning NEW Search helpers by what you need done, not just the exact keywords. Sintra matches them to what you mean. Helpers in your recommendations NEW Sintra now suggests relevant helpers throughout the app, on your homepage and right where you're working, so you find the right one without searching. CHAT A far more capable chat We rebuilt the engine behind Sintra. It handles longer, multi-step work without losing the thread, and it can do things you used to need a whole stack of separate tools for. Make videos that sell IMPROVED Sintra now generates short, on-brand video ads with audio, straight from a prompt, in every workspace. Preview the scenes as a storyboard before you spend a credit, then add titles, edit the text, and polish the final cut. Let Sintra use the web for you NEW Sintra can log into third-party apps through a built-in browser and get things done there directly. It's a simple alternative to integrations when a tool doesn't have one. Just ask a helper to do something in one of your tools, and it opens the browser to handle it. Build slides & presentations NEW Ask Sintra to build a full slide deck or presentation right inside chat. It comes back structured, on-brand, and ready to export. A built-in text editor NEW Whenever Sintra writes something, a proper editor opens right there in the chat, so you can format, tweak, and polish it before you use it. Choose how deeply it thinks NEW Control how much reasoning Sintra puts in. Pick Spark, Smart, or Pro in the chat box before you send: light for quick answers, deep for complex work. Deeper thinking uses more credits, so you set the balance. Experience A Sintra that fits how you work We reworked the whole app to fit how you actually work. It surfaces what matters, when it matters, so Sintra feels easier, more pleasant, and more like yours. A homepage that works for you IMPROVED Tasks and automations now live together in one redesigned home, Automations. It's simpler to set up and easier to track, and Sintra now recommends what's worth automating next, so more of your busywork runs itself. Automations, reimagined IMPROVED Tasks and automations now live together in one redesigned home, Automations. It's simpler to set up and easier to track, and Sintra now recommends what's worth automating next, so more of your busywork runs itself. Notifications, upgraded IMPROVED A new notifications system and bell inbox pull every reply, result, and approval into one place, including updates from your helpers and automations. Integrations Connect everything you use Your whole stack in one place. Sintra plugs into the tools you already use to run your business, so everything works together instead of living in scattered tabs. 1,000+ integrations and counting IMPROVED Tasks and automations now live together in one redesigned home, Automations. It's simpler to set up and easier to track, and Sintra now recommends what's worth automating next, so more of your busywork runs itself. Share integrations across your team NEW Connected integrations can now be private or public. Make one public and your teammates can reuse it in a click, so shared company accounts like socials and email are easy for everyone to connect. Credits Credits, made simple Everything you do in Sintra runs on credits, included with your plan and refreshed each month. This season we made the whole system easier to understand and manage. See where every credit goes NEW A detailed usage log in your credit settings shows exactly what each action cost, so there are no surprises and it's easy to see what's worth automating.
